verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a native sync of invoices, payments, or revenue-recognition entries to a general ledger or ERP such as QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite. The revenue-recognition doc describes automated support for accounting standards, not ERP export. Webhooks are only a developer building block for constructing such a sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery
